title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Greek Theatre, Los Angeles | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 14 June 2026.

It was the final show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s tour of the USA, which lasted for 12 dates in May and June 2026.

For the finale, ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’, the band was joined by drummer Jim Keltner, as well as guests including Mike Campbell and David Paich.

Starr had previously performed at the Greek Theatre on 3 and 4 September 1989, 11 and 12 August 1992, 18 and 19 August 1995, 2 August 2008, 7 August 2010, 21 July 2012, 19 July 2014, 2 July 2016, 29 September 2018, 1 September 2019, 15 June 2023, and 8 September 2024.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
